statusDefinitions.TRAINED_FOR_INTAKE: All required gates have evidence and the segment can independently validate AI artifacts.
statusDefinitions.IN_PROGRESS: Substantive independent evidence exists, but one or more required gates or review decisions remain open.
statusDefinitions.NOT_STARTED: Only a placeholder or insufficient source evidence exists; no Test Solution rules are certified.
statusDefinitions.REVIEW_REQUIRED: A source, semantic, approval, or SME decision prevents certification.

CARD_TYPE_CATALOG.note: Pilot and only context: all 16 Table 1/Table 2 card types, pages 1-10. Every PAN range (100 total, including the 63-row Visa Fleet block) is independently re-derived from the source page text, not hand-entered. The Visa Fleet BIN prefixes cross-check 63/63 against the independently trained Petroleum 2025-1 Visa Fleet catalog. Phases 0 to 7 are drafted (14 ranged BRs; Debit and EBT are placeholder rows excluded from ranged BRs) and phase 8 is partial (43/43 mutations caught by the draft validator, but ATL105 wire serialization is not demonstrated). Phases 9 and 10 remain blocked. Draft requirements and tests are not independent Test Solution evidence, no host execution or SME approval is recorded, and no model weights changed.
